settings.moveDataDir.confirm: The database, images and backups will be copied to “{{dir}}”, then the app will restart. The old folder stays where it is — delete it manually once you have checked everything is there.
settings.theme.hint: This version ships the dark Aurora theme only
settings.animations.hint: The system "reduce motion" setting takes priority
settings.gameBackdrop: Show backdrop image on the game page
settings.export.hint: Database and all images in one file
settings.import.hint: Current data will be replaced (a backup is made first)
settings.wipe.hint: Database, images, backups and Google sign-in will be removed
settings.wipe.confirm: Type УДАЛИТЬ to confirm. This cannot be undone.
settings.sources.intro: The game form can fill its fields from external sources. Every request is made by the app itself, on your action — nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.sources.steamDesc: Title, description, developer and publisher, genres, release date, cover and hero art, Metacritic score. Texts come in the interface language when the game has a translation.
settings.sources.rawgDesc: Approximate time to beat, Metacritic score, studios, genres, tags, platforms, background art. Descriptions are English only.
settings.sources.igdbDesc: Time to beat (main / with extras / 100 %), series, modes, themes, alternative titles, cover.
settings.sources.igdbTwitchNote: Creating an application requires Twitch two-factor authentication by phone number, and not every country is accepted. If that is unavailable, use RAWG above: it also provides a time to beat, though as a single averaged number.
settings.sources.noBundledKeyHint: The RAWG key is set when the app is built, in the .env file (MAIN_VITE_RAWG_KEY). This build has none, so filling from RAWG is unavailable — the other sources still work.
settings.sources.noEncryption: Windows secure storage (DPAPI) is unavailable — there is nowhere to keep the keys encrypted.
settings.sources.step1: Create a free application at dev.twitch.tv (category: Application Integration).
settings.sources.step2: Set the OAuth Redirect URL to http://localhost — it is never used, but the field is required.
settings.sources.step3: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret and paste them here.
settings.sources.cacheHint: Responses are kept for a day so repeat searches don't spend the request budget
settings.sources.attribution: Keys are stored encrypted by Windows and never reach the database, exports or logs. Game data provided by:
settings.hotkeys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the new keys. Esc cancels.
settings.hotkeys.conflict: That shortcut is already taken by “{{action}}”
